youtube_description:
After some time alone on an island in the UP, it could start to get lonely for Drew and Kara. Luckily, the rest of the crew is on their way! Dick, Sam, Jon and Emily are headed off to Fish Lake in the Hiawatha National Forest in Michigan's Upper Peninsula. They'll join Drew and Kara on this island adventure full of friends, food, fun... AND FISHING!!!

Thanks for watching! Please remember to give this video a thumbs up and SUBSCRIBE to our channel then click the bell so you'll be notified when we head out to catch those world class Michigan Northern Pike next week.
